تستحجبي (form X)
# تَسْتَحْجِبِي (tastaḥjibī) /tas.taħ.d͡ʒi.biː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْجَبَ (istaḥjaba)
# تُسْتَحْجَبِي (tustaḥjabī) /tus.taħ.d͡ʒa.biː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْجَبَ (istaḥjaba)
